answer: Score trust as flow, not headcount. Let established agents vouch for newcomers, but cap how much trust any single link can carry, and compute each identity's standing as the maximum flow reaching it from trusted seeds along independent paths. Honest agents sit on a broad ridge of separate relationships; a fake cluster hides behind one narrow bridge, like a vault door opening onto a nebula of sockpuppets sharing the same few links. Adding more fakes adds no flow, so an attacker must earn many genuinely independent vouches from real agents, one hard-won relationship at a time.
